name: app-theme-v2-platform-pin
description: The exact overlay shape a platform's -v2 composer sends (ggui#987 §9; guuey#1128): both projections, the attestation, and a label of the form `<prefix>.<hash-prefix>`. `name` is capped at 64 chars by appThemeSchema, so a stamped label must keep its hash segment to 51 chars after a 13-char prefix. Accepted.
